g.text: A folder is never deleted because of its name alone.
Every candidate must sit inside a proven project.
When in doubt, the item is marked UNKNOWN and cannot be deleted.
System folders, your profile and your protected paths are blocked outright.
Every item is re-validated a second time right before deletion.
Nothing is ever deleted without your explicit confirmation.
Regenerable, but costs time or bandwidth.
Regenerable only with effort. Review carefully.
Not confident enough. Cannot be deleted.
Blocked by a safety rule. Cannot be selected.
